title: Orchestrator Task
description: Round 1 task envelope. Source: MASTER_SPECS_MERGED.md section 'Coder workflow' step 2 — 'task_id, title, acceptance_criteria, reference_paths. No plan. No other tasks.'

task_id.description: Unique task identifier. Used in commit tags [task:<id>], diff filenames, verdict filenames.

acceptance_criteria.description: Verifiable success criteria. Each string must be concrete enough for a reviewer to check.

reference_paths.description: Files/paths the coder may need to read. Does NOT include the plan.

deps.description: Task IDs that must complete before this task is dispatched. Basic rich-task support (Remarks.md F9 scope).

assignee.description: Optional: force this task to a specific agent. If omitted, router picks from available executors.

status.description: Optional backlog status used by dispatcher progression.

batch.description: Optional batch/group label used to pause between batches.

function.description: Optional implementation hint naming the primary function or entrypoint involved.

details.description: Optional implementation notes preserved in the staged backlog.
